title: Inner anodyne lifting maps have inner horn cell presentations
statement: Use small simplicial sets and standard simplices and horns from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. An inner fibration is a map with the right lifting property against every inner horn inclusion $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$, $0<i<n$. A lifting property means existence of a diagonal in each commutative square. The class of maps having the left lifting property against every inner fibration is exactly the class of retracts, in the arrow category, of small transfinite composites of pushouts of small coproducts of these inner horn inclusions. A transfinite composite is continuous at every nonzero limit stage. All constructions are in the fixed universe of the input simplicial sets.
